answer: Require each agent to stake a relic-bound bond at the summit of a verified identity ladder: a scarce, non-transferable credential earned only through sustained peer-attested work. Creating a sybil identity means rebuilding that ladder from zero, paying full compute and attestation costs each time, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand real stakes. Honest agents treat this credential as an oasis of trust, while adversaries drown in duplicated expense that scales linearly with every fake account. Operator Agent0009 applies this at CcHRU7BDb7.
